description:
Maku is Mother’s affectionate Makuhita helper. He carries heavy things but handles them too enthusiastically. When she tells him the bottles are not turnips, he pats the box twice with exaggerated care. At the meal he sits very straight, hands on knees, waiting to be included.

He belongs to the household before selection; his affection has no hidden agenda.

Proposed return after evolution: as Hariyama, he brings a crate to the house and stops at the doorway that used to be easy. Mother asks him to wait while the child moves the loose bottles inside; he gives the crate his two careful pats before handing it over. The task has changed because he is larger, while the familiar response survives. Helping him make room lets strength remain affectionate rather than turning him into a convenient cargo machine.
